description: Write a record of what was reported as approved for a purchase on any payment rail. The approver is a name supplied by the calling agent; this does not confirm who approved. BotSupply does not hold or move the money. Returns receipt_id, a public receipt_url, and an edit_token shown once. If approver_contact is an email, also issues a single-use expiring confirm link. When no email provider is configured, the response includes confirm_url and nothing is sent; the caller delivers that link. A click is a signed hash-chain event. approver_confirmation.status stays unconfirmed until the person with access to that contact clicks Confirm or Decline. confirmed means that person clicked Confirm. It is not a legal-identity check, and an unconfirmed receipt is not a verification of the person. Without an email approver_contact, pay_allowed is true only when the price cap is under RECEIPT_CONFIRM_THRESHOLD (default 100, in the price cap currency). At or above that threshold the receipt still records and shows that confirmation is required, and pay_allowed stays false. Poll get_receipt and pay only when pay_allowed is true. Optional public_view is full (default) or redacted, with optional public_scope for the redacted public text. That display setting is outside the hash. No wallet or API key. Rate limited per IP. Same as POST /v1/receipts.

agent_id.description: Optional id of the agent that will pay. Not a BotSupply API key.

agent_name.description: Optional display name of the paying agent.

approver.description: Name the calling agent reports as the approver. Not confirmation that this person approved.

approver_contact.description: Optional email string, or { channel: "email", address }. An email issues a one-time confirm link. The address is stored only as a hash. sms is reserved and rejected until a sender exists. A non-email string is stored as a hash only and does not issue a link.

confirmation_webhook_url.description: Optional public https URL. After the contact clicks Confirm or Decline, BotSupply POSTs { receipt_id, approver_confirmation }. Best-effort. Poll get_receipt if it does not arrive. Requires an email approver_contact.

external_payment_ref.description: Optional id from the payment rail. BotSupply does not look it up.

merchant_url.description: Optional http or https URL for the merchant.

payment_rail.description: How the agent will pay. Examples: stripe_link, card, x402, botsupply_wallet.

price_cap_amount.description: Maximum amount reported as approved. A positive decimal, for example 25 or "19.95".

price_cap_currency.description: Currency code, 3 to 10 letters, for example USD or USDC.

public_scope.description: Optional scope shown on the public receipt while public_view is redacted. The stored scope is unchanged and is what the approver confirms.

public_view.description: Public display. full (default) or redacted. Stored outside the hash, so changing it later does not break verify. redacted shows initials, hides contacts, and shortens payment refs and proof values.

scope.description: What was reported as approved, in plain text.

name: record_approval
title: Record reported approval
